title: Read a JSON body
summary: Fastify: Read a JSON body. Send an empty object and compare the response.
introduction: Fastify can parse JSON bodies. Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}.
learningObjectives: Read a JSON body with Fastify
Send an empty object and compare the response

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Read a JSON body

blocks.text: The JSON parser provides the body object. A valid title reaches the 201 response.
Send an empty object and compare the response.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Content-Type tells the server how to read the body.
